[[File:Imperial_Lieutenant_Commander.jpg|thumb|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Lieutenant Commander]]
'''Lieutenant Commander''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] used by several navies and starfighter corps. It ranked between [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] (or in the case of some starfighter corps, between [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and Commander<ref name="Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>). Given that a Naval Lieutenant (as a rule) equated to an Army [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], a Lieutenant Commander equated roughly to a [[Major/Legends|Major]].

In the Rebel Alliance's starfighter corps., the rank of Lieutenant Commander was adopted post-[[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], and was ranked between Captain and Commander. Its insignia was a gold-trim patch on the left shoulder blade with two large red dots, one for each of the top corners, and one small red dot on the bottommost center,<ref name="Alliance" /> a similar design for the design for the rank of Captain pre-Battle of Hoth.<ref name="X-wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>
